5 تمضّر He asserted himself to be related, or to belong, to the race of مُضَر. (A, K.) See 2. ―
-b2- He entered into a league (تَعَصَّبَ, A: in the copies of the K, تَغَضَّبَ; but the former, with the two unpointed letters, is the right reading: TA:) with, (A,) or for, (K,) the race of مُضَر. (A, K.) ―
-b3- He affected to be like, or imitated, or assimilated himself to, the race of مُضَر. (S, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
